style: 3D cartoon, Pixar-like, plush fur, deadpan slapstick
subject: one grey chinchilla, big ears, small gold crown, half-lidded deadpan eyes, same all clip. Explosive four-paw leaps, full backflip, sits upright as a column, one hard shake doubling his fur, dead freeze with only whiskers trembling
set: three wide shallow bowls stacked as a podium, each step half his height: bottom scratched grey plastic, middle silver, top gold with a big embossed diamond and a wide coin slot on its outer side facing the lens, a finger below the rim. Same grey ash in all three, sparkling only in the lit gold one. A coin lies on the floor. Furry-windshield shotgun mic bottom right, unmoving. Whole tower in frame always, gold rim visible from 4.6
lighting: bright daylight; hard back and top light, plumes against it; front fill so muzzle and mouth read at 0.9-2.3; the gold bowl glow is the only sparkle source; exposure high

audio.delivery: dry deadpan, even pace; SHORST-ka, stress the first syllable; PREH-mee-oom pod-PEE-sok
audio.pacing: the 3.0 and 4.6 lines run together, no pause, no breath; nikak deliberately slow; he is voiceless after 7.2, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens on every syllable, no voice over

timeline.a: opens mid-action: he erupts from the grey bowl in a full backflip, ash mushrooming up. Landed by 0.75 upright on the rim, open mouth at the lens, clear of the plume. The blast tips a floor coin onto its edge, it rolls to the tower
locomotion only, touches nothing; from crouch to full height on hind legs, chest out, chin up, grey dust sheeting off him. The coin rolls in and rattles to rest by 2.3
he launches off the rim, rams the coin up into the slot with both paws, hangs by his weight, hind paws scrabbling. The slot swallows it and lights gold inside, up-lighting his muzzle and the dust
travel only: explosive leap from grey tier to silver, hind paws punching a puff out of the grey bowl
same sentence, no breath. One arc: off the silver onto the gold rim, up to full height, top of frame, lit gold from below
deliberately slow. Total freeze, only whiskers trembling, eyes in the lens. The slot pulses once
PUNCH: on the spot he topples backwards into the gold bowl, paws up last. Hollow metal thud
he is hidden: a dust blast twice the first fills the frame, lit gold, sparkling. It hits the mic, the windshield bends and greys

he rises glowing from the settling dust, one hard shake, dust off as a sparkling ring. Ending the shake the slot blinks red and the sparkle stops with it: same dust, now plain grey ash, only the light changed

one downward move: his right paw sweeps the crown off his head, over the rim into the slot, the same move sinking him into the bowl, upright at the lens, deadpan. Red back to gold, dust sparkles again

continuity: one coin: floor to 0.9, rolling to 2.3, into the slot at 3.0, never returns. One crown: on his head to 9.3, stays on through the tumble, in the slot from 9.5
must_appear: the three bowls are one podium, never merged; thick dust is the subject, frame sharp and clean; slot light is practical, not blown out; the mic is deliberate, never touched
negative_prompt: a second chinchilla or reflection, a second coin or crown, coin or crown returning, glitter or confetti, dust sparkling under red light, any lettering, subtitles, watermark, English speech, people, hands, other animals, smiling, laughing, cuts, slow motion, speed ramp, any voice from him after 7.2, accented Russian, floating props, silence in the tail, grain, fog, sepia, horizontal, night, dusk, dark scene, low key
